pages.title: Ore Guide
pages.text:
Where each metal comes from in this pack, read from the mods' world generation data. Depths are Y levels, Overworld unless noted.

Ores go further when [#](2E5AAC)[crushed](entry://materials/ore_doubling)[#](). Drillable veins: [#](2E5AAC)[Ore Excavation](entry://industry/ore_excavation)[#]().

pages.title: Vanilla and Create
pages.text:
Coal, copper, iron, gold, redstone, lapis, diamond and emerald are vanilla. Terrain mods such as Tectonic change where they end up.

**Zinc** comes from Create: Y -63 to 70. Brass is copper plus zinc.

pages.title: Zinc Ore
pages.text: Overworld, Y -63 to 70, stone and deepslate. Northstar's planets have their own zinc ores, and both count as zinc ore in recipes.

pages.title: Create Nuclear
pages.text:
- **Lead**: Y -16 to 60
- **Uranium**: Y -63 to 16, sparse
- **Thorium**: Y -16 to 55
- **Nitrate**: Y -63 to 64

Autunite, a building stone, forms striated veins below Y 16.

pages.title: Lead Ore
pages.text: The pack's only generated lead, since TFMG's lead ore is off. Mining drops Raw Lead. The ore block itself has no crushing recipe; crush the raw lead.

pages.title: Uranium Ore
pages.text: Deep and rare. Feeds [#](2E5AAC)[the reactor](entry://industry/nuclear)[#](). Alex's Caves adds its own uranium in Toxic Caves.

pages.title: TFMG
pages.text:
- **Nickel**: Y -63 to 20
- **Lithium**: Y -63 to -5, sparse
- **Bauxite**: a stone that crushes to powder, the start of aluminum
- Galena: decorative, not an ore
- Lead: off\
Oil: [#](2E5AAC)[Oil](entry://industry/tfmg_oil)[#]().

pages.title: Nickel Ore
pages.text: Y -63 to 20. Nickel goes into TFMG alloys such as constantan. Lithium ore sits deeper, below Y -5.

pages.title: Northstar planets
pages.text:
Titanium and tungsten exist only off-world, in planet-specific blocks.
- Titanium: Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus
- Tungsten: Mercury only
- Zinc, copper, iron, gold, redstone, diamond: all four\
[#](2E5AAC)[Planets](entry://space/planets)[#]()

pages.title: Titanium Ore
pages.text: Moon, Mars, Mercury and Venus each have their own block. Drops raw titanium, which smelts to a titanium ingot.

pages.title: More planet ores
pages.text:
- Glowstone: Moon, Mercury, Venus
- Lapis: Moon, Mercury
- Nether quartz: Mars, Venus
- Coal: Venus

Mercury's tungsten ore is plentiful. It crushes to Crushed Raw Tungsten.

pages.title: Other Overworld ores
pages.text:
Other mods add Overworld metals:
- **Platinum** (Create Propulsion): Y -63 to about 16
- **Mithril** (Iron's Spells 'n Spellbooks): Y -63 to -38, very deep

pages.title: Platinum Ore
pages.text: Create Propulsion's metal. Crushes and washes like any Create ore. Deep Overworld.

pages.title: Mithril Ore
pages.text: Y -63 to -38. Crushing gives Crushed Mithril from Create: Wizardry, which can be washed or smelted.

pages.title: Dimension ores
pages.text:
- **Aether**: zanite, gravitite, ambrosium and icestone in holystone
- **Alex's Caves**: galena iron in Magnetic Caves, uranium in Toxic Caves, coal and redstone in Forlorn Hollows
- **Better End**: thallasium, ender and amber ore

pages.title: Zanite Ore
pages.text: Aether holystone. Zanite and ambrosium ores have Create crushing recipes, so a Crushing Wheel doubles them too.

pages.title: Not mined
pages.text:
No ore generation of their own:
- Bronze (Alloyed) and steel (TFMG) are alloys
- Create Crafts & Additions: electrum is an alloy
- Cataclysm: its metals are not mined

Twilight Forest grows Iron, Copper and Gold Oreberry bushes instead of veins.
